data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 was $139.4m. Using the claims development information in note 9, the syndicate experienced net favourable prioryear development of approximately $6.1m (a ~4.4% release of opening reserves), driven by favourable claims development on older underwriting years (notably the 2020 column and older years). The report also highlights a challenging 2021/2022 catastrophe environment (Hurricanes Ida and Ian, Storms Uri and Elliot, flooding events and the Volker hail event) which impacted the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years but, on balance, the prior years produced a release when assessed at year end.

The total estimate as at 31 December 2022 included within claims outstanding is $180.1m (2021: $114.8m).

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit textual gross prioryear movement figure was stated. Prior-year development was calculated from the claims development percentages and ultimate amounts presented in note 9 (claims development table). The exact_reserve_text is blank because the report does not provide a single-sentence gross prior-year movement statement. Amounts are reported in the report's functional currency (USD). Confidence in the PYD figure is moderate (0.8) because it was derived from the triangle/percentages rather than an explicit gross movement line.
